headline: Reflexive-Claude-Code: Agentic Workflow for Claude
short_description: A skills-driven agentic context engineering workflow for Claude Code that structures AI agent behavior through composable skills, rules, and CLAUDE.md guidance.
author: wayne930242

sections.overview:
Reflexive-Claude-Code is a structured workflow system for Claude Code that organizes AI agent behavior through composable skills, project rules, and CLAUDE.md configuration. It provides a plugin-based architecture under .claude-plugin that includes skill authoring, subagent planning, parallel agent dispatch, and reflexive reviewing capabilities. The system addresses common context engineering challenges such as CLAUDE.md bloat, hard-rule compliance gaps, and agent orchestration by offering templates, reviewers, and guidance grounded in 2026 prompting research. It supports monorepo setups with nested CLAUDE.md files, conditional instruction dispatch, and a safety bypass prevention system for destructive operations. Developers building complex agentic workflows with Claude Code benefit from the structured scaffolding and opinionated best practices this skill provides.
Structuring Claude Code agent behavior with composable, reviewable skills
Dispatching parallel subagents for large or multi-step development tasks
Enforcing safety rules against destructive operations like force pushes or test deletion
Authoring and validating CLAUDE.md files to avoid context bloat and improve agent performance
